name: worldcup-predictor-2026
description: FIFA World Cup 2026 prediction game — static HTML + React (CDN). JSX is precompiled to plain JS so browsers never download/compile Babel at runtime.

scripts.build: babel rings.jsx -o dist/rings.js && babel components.jsx -o dist/components.js && babel screens.jsx -o dist/screens.js && babel screens2.jsx -o dist/screens2.js && babel app.jsx -o dist/app.js
